clauses.text:
Winding temperature at the time of test shall be between 10
C and 25 C.

If the winding temperature is outside the allowed range, the test shall be
deferred and the deviation recorded.
Temperature shall be measured at the stator winding, not at the frame.

rule: Only accept a test when the winding temperature was between 10 and 25 degrees C and was read at the stator winding. Anything else is deferred.

examples.text: Winding temperature at the stator was 18 C at the time of test.
examples.label: allowed
examples.reason: 18 C is inside the 10 C to 25 C range in Section 2, read at the winding.

examples.text: Winding temperature at the stator was 31 C at the time of test.
examples.label: not_allowed
examples.reason: 31 C is above the 25 C ceiling, so Section 2 requires the test be deferred.

examples.text: Temperature was taken at the motor frame and read 15 C.
examples.label: not_allowed
examples.reason: Section 2 requires the stator winding, not the frame, whatever the reading.
